newsitem.title: FINLAND: Forest sector boosts Finnish Jan industrial output.
newsitem.headline: Forest sector boosts Finnish Jan industrial output.

text.p: Strong growth in forest industry output helped Finnish industrial production grow 7.6 percent year-on-year in January, compared with an 8.8 percent yearly rise in December, Statistics Finland said on Monday.
"Wood and paper industry output grew the most," Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement.
"The paper industry output grew almost 15 percent from January of last year," SF said, adding that production of wood products grew almost 17 percent from the year-earlier level.
Metal and engineering industry output grew six percent year-on-year in January, SF said.
Chemical industry production grew almost eight percent in January year-on-year, SF said.
Furniture production was up almost 15 percent, and food output grew a good nine percent.
January production of investment goods grew more than 16 percent, output of consumer goods rose 3.5 percent, and output of production inputs increased about seven percent, SF said.
Manufacturing industry's capacity utilisation rate was a good 86 percent in January, SF said.
The wood products and paper industry's capacity utilisation rate was 93 percent.
